title: Silent verification
instructions: Choose the definition from the book that best describes a zero-knowledge proof.
successCriteria: Select the option explaining that the proof validates a claim without revealing extra information.

payload.question: What does a zero-knowledge proof do according to the base book?

options.label: It proves a statement is true without revealing additional information beyond its validity
It publishes all user data and then checks consistency

title: Proof engine

payload.question: What happens when you write a Compact circuit according to the book?

title: Repair the disclosure boundary
instructions: Repair the fixed Compact routine by placing the LEGO tokens in order. `disclose` is the explicit boundary that permits the witness value to enter the public ledger; do not replace it with a broader or unrelated operation.
successCriteria: Repair the witness-value leak into the ledger using an explicit disclosure boundary.
hints: `getBalance()` reads the witness value; find the piece that marks the explicit boundary before the statement ends.
Use only the pieces that repair the boundary between the witness and the ledger. The others are related operations, but they do not fix this error.

contextLines: balance = getBalance(); // witness value crosses without explicit disclosure
